title: Ink Game Script
features:
+ RLGL Tp to End
+ RLGL Helper
>Carries a random injured person to the end
+ Dalgona/Honeycomb Anti-Crack
>Removes crack parts. (You will have to do it manually but it's easy since it can't break)
+ Dalgona/Honeycomb One Click
>Finish Dalgona with one click. (Just follow the notification's instructions)
+ INF Stamina (Hide&Seek)
>Unlimited stamina during Hide & Seek
+ Glass Bridge
+ Auto Tug of War
+ Exit Doors ESP
+ Mingle ESP
+ Highlight Players
>Esp for all players, and while the game is "Hide & Seek" esp changes color
+ Reduce knockback
>Take less knockback from push (Doesn't prevent ragdoll & might be buggy)
+ AimLock Nearest Player
>Makes your character aim at nearest player (somewhat useful for fighting)
+ Highlight NPCs (Rebellion)
+ Increase NPCs Hitbox (Rebellion)
>Use "Highlight enemies" to see the expanded hitbox
+ Weapons/Guns: Inf Ammo | No Spread | Rapid Fire
+ Remove Injured Walking
+ Anti Stun/Slowness
+ Noclip
+ Speed + Speed Power
+ Select animation + Play animation
